gloss: to make a profit; to earn money

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {儲|もう}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to make a profit; to earn money
definitions.explanation: To gain financial profit from a business, investment, or transaction.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧{儲|もう}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧らしい。
examples.english: That store seems to be making a good profit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{数万円|すうまんえん}{儲|もう}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people earn tens of thousands of yen a month from side jobs.

notes:
Refers specifically to gaining financial profit. The emphasis is on the result of earning money rather than the labor involved. Often used in casual conversation about business success or investment gains.

ASPECT (ている):
{儲|もう}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of being profitable or currently earning money.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{儲|もう}ける (make money on stocks)
- ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{儲|もう}ける (profit from business)
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧{儲|もう}ける (earn a lot)
- ぼろ{儲|もう}け (making a killing, huge profit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ — to earn (emphasizes working to earn income, not just profit)
- ⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧ — homophone but means to establish or set up; written with a different kanji

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese culture, openly discussing how much one has profited can be seen as boastful. The expression ⟦{儲|もう}け{話|ばなし}→儲け話：30458_moukebanashi⟧ (money-making scheme) often carries a slightly suspicious connotation.

cross_references.notes: {設|もう}ける means to establish or set up
